versions.changelog:
meituan-ai v0.1.0

- Initial release registering the "美团" (Meituan) skill for hot trend analysis.
- Supports information retrieval and summary for publicly available merchants and deals on Meituan.
- Provides concise merchant/product summaries, comparisons, and highlights (ratings, prices, promotions).
- Automation is lightweight; no ordering, reverse engineering, or bypassing of platform controls.
- Only analyzes public pages with frequency and compliance reminders; results intended for internal insight.
